title: 第15章 金手指第16章 神通伟力求追读
slug: 方士开局我给秦始皇画大饼
content_zh:
与此同时，另一边。
“吱嘎——砰！”
一声闷响，房门被邹云以最快的速度关上，彻底隔绝外界一切。
他整个人紧紧抵住门板，心脏在胸腔里狂跳不止，巨大的兴奋在邹云脑海奔涌。
‘刚才那感应......绝非错觉！’
他在心中无声呐喊，深深吸气，强迫自己冷静下来。
冰凉的空气吸入肺腑，带来一丝清明。邹云猛地闭上眼，屏息凝神，顺着本能将全部心神沉浸其中。
嗡！
意念所至，一道散发荧光的面板，竟毫无征兆在他面前浮现。
方框内只有寥寥数行清晰的字迹：
【姓名：邹云】
【修真点：2000】
【神通：兵解飞升：刀兵加身而不死，可盗取天地之炁，重活一世。】
（注：身躯越完整，复苏时间越短，反之则越长！）
整个面板结构极其简单，除了这三项核心信息，再无任何多余事项。
“这就是......我的金手指吗？！！！”
热流猛得涌上眼眶，邹云鼻子一酸，好悬没当场哭出来。
开局便是地狱模式，天知道这段时间，他是怎么熬过来的！
若非他前世身为一名资深的业余魔术爱好者，在绝境中灵光乍现，想出那个‘兵解飞升’的障眼法。
恐怕，他邹云的尸骨早就和那四百多个倒霉蛋，一同烂在咸阳宫外的深坑里了，哪能活着见到今天的太阳。

如今终于苦尽甘来，在这荣膺大方师的时刻，等来金手指。
这巨大的转折，让邹云心中激荡难耐，一股豪气油然而生。
现在，他终于也可以说上一句。
“我邹云能有今天，全靠我自己的努力！”
“深蓝，加点！！让我看看你的极限！！！！”
邹云迫不及待的伸出手指，朝着神通那栏狠狠点下去！
可很快，他脸上的狂喜僵在原地，系统面板压根就没有任何反应。
邹云不信邪地又在面板上各处点戳、滑动，甚至尝试用意识去按。忙活半天，面板却依旧纹丝不动。
“很好，看来不是直接加点的类型！”
邹云嘴角微微抽动，强压下心中失落，试图安慰自己。
“没关系，我就喜欢有操作的，纯数值太无脑了，不符合我的气质。”
他深吸一口气，重整旗鼓，眼神变得锐利，用一种看透一切的目光，对着面板笃定道。
“就决定是你了，出来吧，系统商城！！！”

content_en:
Meanwhile, on the other side.
"Squeak-bang!"
With a muffled sound, Zou Yun closed the door as quickly as possible, completely cutting off the outside world.
He pressed his whole body tightly against the door panel, his heart beating wildly in his chest, and huge excitement rushed through Zou Yun's mind.
'That feeling just now... was definitely not an illusion! ’
He screamed silently in his heart, took a deep breath, and forced himself to calm down.
The cold air is breathed into the lungs, bringing a sense of clarity. Zou Yun closed his eyes suddenly, held his breath and concentrated, and followed his instinct to immerse himself in it.
Buzz!
As soon as his thoughts hit him, a fluorescent panel appeared in front of him without any warning.
There are only a few lines of clear writing in the box:
[Name: Zou Yun]
[Cultivation Points: 2000]
[Supernatural power: Weapon solution and ascension: The weapon is added to the body without death. It can steal the energy of heaven and earth and live a new life. 】
(Note: The more complete the body, the shorter the recovery time, and vice versa!)
The entire panel structure is extremely simple. Apart from these three core information, there is nothing superfluous.
"Is this...my golden finger?!!!"
Heat surged into his eyes so fiercely that Zou Yun's nose felt sore and he almost didn't want to cry on the spot.
The beginning was hell mode. God knows how he survived this period!
If he hadn't been a senior amateur magic enthusiast in his previous life, he suddenly had an idea in a desperate situation and came up with the 'soldier's ascension' trick.
I'm afraid that Zou Yun's corpse had long since died in the pit outside Xianyang Palace together with those four hundred unlucky people. How could he live to see the sun today?
Now the pain has finally come to an end, and at this moment when I am honored as a great alchemist, I have been waiting for the golden finger.
This huge turn of events made Zou Yun feel unbearable, and a surge of pride arose spontaneously.
Now, he can finally say something.
"I, Zou Yun, am today only because of my own efforts!"
"Dark Blue, add more!! Let me see your limit!!!"
Zou Yun couldn't wait to stretch out his fingers and tap hard on the column of magical powers!
But soon, the ecstasy on his face froze in place, and the system panel showed no response at all.
Zou Yun unbelievingly poked and swiped everywhere on the panel, and even tried to press it with his mind. After working for a long time, the panel remained motionless.
"Very good, it doesn't seem to be the type to add points directly!"
The corners of Zou Yun's mouth twitched slightly, suppressing the loss in his heart and trying to comfort himself.
"It doesn't matter, I just like things with operations. Pure numerical values are too brainless and don't suit my temperament."
He took a deep breath, regrouped, his eyes became sharp, and he spoke firmly to the panel with a look that could see through everything.
"The decision is yours, come out, system mall!!!"
